description: Open start times (up to 12) on one date for one service, when the place takes online bookings. Times are in the place's own time zone. Pass `memberId` (from get_place) to see only that team member's times. Use it when the person wants an appointment and asks when; then give them booking_link. For walking in now, use join_link instead. If the place doesn't take online bookings, the service isn't offered, or the day is full, it says so (try another date).

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, in the place's time zone

memberId.description: Optional team member id from get_place

name: available_times
title: Open booking times
